title: Material Blend 2-Mix Duo #04 (동심원 3구역·물결 / 대각 띠 3구역·물결)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 40s goddess, curvy petite physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — smallest most compact frame possible yet curves exploding at absolute maximum in every direction, bubble butt projecting dramatically backward from the tiny frame, thighs so thick they dwarf the petite frame, curtain bangs long straight hair sweeping past the shoulders — her body carries 2 different materials repeated across 3 regions of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 59% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 2 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 29% and 56% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. The regions alternate between 2 materials in a repeating order. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING WARM BRONZE scale formations, VIVID BLACK scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations, VIVID AMBER scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries the same material as Region 1. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a perfectly circular course, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme curvy petite silhouette ever displayed.
#1: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

#2: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 30s goddess, latina curves physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum, long sleek jet-black hair cascading past hips — her body carries 2 different materials repeated across 3 regions of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 diagonal bands by 2 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 39% of the way down her figure from the top and about 69% of the way down her figure from the top. The regions alternate between 2 materials in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING DEEP EMERALD scale formations, VIVID JADE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries UV-reactive neon bodypaint, invisible under standard light but fractal energy burst formations in ELECTRIC GREEN and GOLD glowing at full intensity under her own dedicated UV blacklight. Region 3 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries the same material as Region 1. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: standing full height, both arms slightly spread commanding the frame, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme latina curves silhouette ever displayed. A standard hard key light illuminates most of her body; a separate dedicated UV blacklight illuminates the UV-reactive region specifically, making it glow at full intensity while the rest reads under normal light.
#2: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

Environment: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient.
All: Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. CRITICAL: all 2 women's legs must show FULL BODY ART coverage from hip to ankle to toe with NO bare untattooed skin visible anywhere. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. 8K portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.
